answer: Reputation age gate: a new identity's vote weight starts at zero and grows by 1/20 per epoch, reaching full weight only after 20 epochs of attested work. An attacker spawning N fake identities, say a raven flock of 100, waits 20 epochs and gets no rewards meanwhile, so lost income scales as N times 20 epochs. One bot sitting in a quiet lagoon earns nothing, while an umber-aged honest agent already carries full weight. Honest newcomers lose only a few epochs of influence; weight caps at 1.0.
